title: Endpoint-level observability and chargeback for embeddings + rerank pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We lack consistent endpoint-level introspection for the embeddings + rerank request flow. Engineers and SREs cannot quickly answer: how much GPU time / KV-cache misses / batching inefficiency is attributable to a specific API route, and how much cost should be charged back to the route owner. This ticket implements tracing propagation, high-cardinality route tags, breakdown metrics (compute, queuing, IO, embedding model cost, reranker model cost), and automated chargeback views so product teams can correlate latency regressions with cost increases and model changes. The work must preserve high throughput and not add more than 3% p90 latency overhead in the hot path.
acceptance_criteria: Trace spans for embeddings and rerank stages emitted end-to-end with route tag and request id
Per-endpoint dashboard in Console showing: tokens processed, GPU-ms per stage, KV-cache hit/miss rate, batch size distribution, and cost attribution (USD) over time
Automated alert: when endpoint GPU-ms per request increases by >30% vs baseline for 10 minutes
Sampling strategy implemented for detailed traces (1% baseline, configurable per-route) and full-trace capture for incidents
Chargeback report exported to CSV for billing pipeline with per-route daily totals
End-to-end test validating trace propagation and metric correctness in staging using synthetic traffic
implementation_notes: Add route_id propagation header across internal services (embed-proxy -> embedding-worker -> rerank-worker -> scorer)
Instrument embedding and rerank modules with fine-grained timers: tokenization, model forward, KV cache lookup, batch assembly, GPU queue wait
Emit metrics with route tag and shard id; use histograms for latency and gauges for current in-flight batches
Cost model: USD per GPU-ms derived from reserved capacity pricing; attach per-stage multiplier for quantized vs fp16 variants
Use existing OpenTelemetry collector; add a low-overhead aggregator for per-route rollups to avoid high-cardinality explosion
Add a sampling toggle in Console for routes to grow trace sample rate for debugging
rollout_plan: Week 1: feature branch + instrumentation in staging; smoke tests for metric correctness
Week 2: enable minimal sampling (0.1%) for 5 canary endpoints; verify no perf regressions
Week 3: expand to 25% of endpoints; enable Console dashboard read-only for PMs; iterate on visuals
Week 4: enable CSV chargeback exports and alerts; run tabletop incident with on-call to validate workflows
Final: flip default sampling to 1% and ship release console-2025.03
test_plan: Synthetic traffic harness hitting embedding+rerank flows with controlled batch sizes to assert metrics
Unit tests for trace context propagation and header preservation
Load test to ensure p95 latency overhead < 3% when instrumentation enabled
Staging validation: compare metrics to naive reference implementation for consistency
Alert firing simulation: artificially inflate GPU-ms in staging and confirm alert evaluates and notifies
